verses.text: Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
lines: Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.

verses.text: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
lines: Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

verses.text: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
lines: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins,

verses.text: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
lines: But there is forgiveness with you,

verses.text: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
lines: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning,
more than watchmen for the morning.

verses.text: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.
lines: for there is loving kindness with Yahweh.

verses.text: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
lines: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
